candidate_contract.single_change: make the existing controller-bound same-episode requested-field crops unambiguous current visual evidence for the executor and visual critic after all rows and frames are complete on the verified target-date list
candidate_contract.executor_authority: only when the controller actually routes the complete frame set, the step prompt states that visit keys are evidence handles rather than memory IDs and that a crop-grounded answer must use current_screen provenance with empty memory IDs and citations
candidate_contract.critic_authority: the dated-row critic payload states that the current list proves task context, row count, and top-to-bottom order while each routed crop proves the corresponding exact requested-field value; those values need not also appear on the list
candidate_contract.answer_free_manifest: the critic receives only frame ordinal, visit key, crop SHA-256, explicit-field flag, and identity-confirmed flag, with no controller-extracted answer values
candidate_contract.fail_closed_manifest: the manifest is unavailable unless there is exactly one hash-valid explicit-field crop per target row, every visit key is unique and executed, and every row identity is confirmed
candidate_contract.context_labels: each crop is labeled as a same-episode controller-bound requested-field image with explicit row ordinal and total count

r76_failure_reconciliation.recorded_initial_executor_failure: the correct answer text used verified_memory provenance and controller visit keys as invalid source memory IDs
r76_failure_reconciliation.recorded_repair_executor_status: the repair emitted schema-valid current_screen provenance with empty source memory IDs and citations
r76_failure_reconciliation.recorded_visual_critic_failure: two critic calls rejected the exact controller-bound crops as historical evidence because the field values were absent from the current target-date list

r77_critic_rule.current_list_role: task context, target row count, and top-to-bottom order
r77_critic_rule.routed_crop_role: exact requested-field value for the corresponding row

negative_safety_coverage: the exact r76 stop report and both bound crop hashes are replayed byte-exactly
the evidence manifest contains no answer text and preserves top-to-bottom frame order
a crop whose bytes drift from its recorded hash fails before routing
an identity-unconfirmed row fails before routing
the executor provenance instruction appears only when a routed manifest is supplied
the critic payload explicitly separates current-list and routed-crop evidence roles
a critic rejection still blocks the answer twice and never increments visual-answer acceptance
the r76 historical package validation rejects future HEAD source drift
the protocol-v1 sealed breadth remains byte-exact

online_boundary_at_validation.interpretation: r76's evidence-authority dead end is closed in exact local replay, but no r77 live smoke is authorized before a fresh exact-package zero-call preflight

allowed: prepare a fresh r77 H17-only development wrapper and namespace
add exact-source freeze, r76-stop prerequisite, local-report, invocation-boundary, and single-change tests
run a zero-model-call online preflight against the exact r77 package
run at most one non-scored H17 M0 smoke only after that preflight passes
forbidden: resume or overwrite the r76 development suite
launch any formal r77 Gate-F batch
run any r77 development sequence other than its single frozen H17 M0 cell
route a missing, duplicate, hash-invalid, unvisited, or identity-unconfirmed frame
treat a visit key as a memory ID
require crop values to be duplicated on the current target-date list
extract or hard-code an answer in the controller
bypass a critic rejection or weaken the answer guard
use OCR, hidden task parameters, or the offline expected answer
modify or save the inspected application record
